$ETH 1896, it finally corrected after fifteen minutes, but after three hours it's still all negative—twelve in total.

They cut down the group that lent money; they cut the lending volume by 80%. The fee rate turned negative, and the shorts began paying interest.

The sell orders on the order book are pinned down; the active selling makes up 62%. The money moved but the price didn’t—can’t make sense of it.

They ground out one position for three days. The more they ground it, the less money there is; the more they grind it, the less momentum the price has.

Pre-play the ending in advance.

#eth $ETH

$ETH 1896，十五分钟终于翻正了，但三小时还是十二根全负。

一个位置磨了三天，钱越磨越少，价越磨越没劲。

提前预演一下结局。
